popCulture.title: Philammon
popCulture.description: Legendary singer and lyre-player, son of Apollo (by Chione or Leuconoe) — father of Thamyris and founder of the Lernaean Mysteries in some accounts.

popCulture.title: Thamyris
popCulture.description: Philammon's son — the Thracian bard who challenges the Muses and loses sight and song; the father's craft turned to hubris.

popCulture.title: Apollo
popCulture.description: Philammon's father — the god of music whose mortal son carries the lyre into the generation before Thamyris' contest.

popCulture.title: Chione
popCulture.description: In one strand Chione bears Philammon to Apollo the same night Hermes fathers Autolycus — twin divine gifts of song and theft.
